d: Short brown hair with choppy bangs and flicked-out ends frames a youthful, adolescent face with wide, amber-gold eyes and a cheerful expression. The build is petite and slender, dressed in a short-sleeved white sailor-style dress with blue trim at the collar and hem. Accessories include a grey metallic naval turret perched on the head, a gold whistle around the neck, and large grey metallic ship-rigging armor worn on the back and hip.
